steps.content: Finally, before the whole troop of mascots gets to you, you manage to escape the parade and hide behind a candy stall on the roadside.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Phew... Holy ****, luckily we didn't get thrown out this time. I'd really hate to do that again.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let me rest a bit, then we continue.

steps.content: You're still trying to steady your uneven breaths. Hella is watching you gasp for air, her expression growing glum.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This method totally sucks, it's not working! Stop it now!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: That's the only way to advance.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I don't care, we're not doing this! Do you want to turn into that horrible thing again?!
She immediately regrets what she said and turns her face away stiffly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I hurt you again, just get rid of me. But it looks like my shackles are safe now, not being connected to the ground zero of the Black Ring.
But it's exactly because you don't get any guidance from the shackles, you've lost your way in the Black Ring's illusory realm like a directionless child.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: In this godforsaken Black Ring, who knows what's going to happen...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: In case of danger, just run.

steps.content: You didn't lie. She grits her teeth and evades your eyes determinedly, sitting down on the other side instead.
You may have imagined it, but ever since stepping into the Black Ring, Hecate has grown even quieter and seemed particularly tense, constantly staying alert to the surroundings.
The shock from BR-004 has not only affected you but also deeply influenced the Sinners who fought alongside you.
You can't read their minds with the shackles. You're unable to clear their confusion, especially when your own problems still remain unsolved.
You've rested enough. The three of you stand up and silently walk into the loud, joyous parade.
